summary: Cinemark Holdings and its subsidiary Cinemark USA filed an 8-K to disclose a Fifth Amendment to their existing credit agreement, reducing term loan interest rates by 0.25% and resetting a soft call provision. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is present. The amendment is a routine refinancing and not a special situation.
